name: MayMoes Cajun Grill (Logan) Mild Grilled Chicken or Catfish & White Rice
whyItWorks: While Cajun spice is normally a flare trigger, MayMoes can grill catfish fillets or chicken breast with mild salt/herb seasoning (no cayenne blackening) over plain steamed white rice with soft French bread.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for Grilled Catfish or Grilled Chicken Breast with NO Cajun cayenne spice (plain butter/salt only) over steamed white rice with French bread.
watchOuts: Avoid blackened spice, spicy jambalaya, crawfish étouffée roux, and deep-fried okra during flares
